messages:
Priya (CS): Aurora Labs onboarding - QA ramp shows 429s after ~20s when they open 150+ tabs. SDK: browser-js v1.5.0.

Hector (Eng): Which endpoint? sample error?

Priya (CS): Mostly /v1/embeddings. Error: `429 {"error":"rate_limited","reason":"preflight_quota"}`. They call /auth/refresh on every tab.

Nina (DevEx): Classic token-per-tab stampede. Quick fix: debounce refresh or share session token across tabs (localStorage or service worker).

Priya (CS): Can we temporarily raise their preflight concurrency so QA can continue? Org: org_aurora_42.

Hector (Eng): I can open a 48h exception for embeddings to 250 concurrent. Will log INF-8230. Need them to deploy fix or we revert.

OpsBot: Exception INF-8230 created: org_aurora_42 embeddings concurrency=250, expires in 48h.

Nina (DevEx): Sending them a small debounce snippet and a service-worker example. Recommend follow-up in 24h to confirm no flapping.

Priya (CS): Thanks — will notify customer and update onboarding ticket. If errors persist after patch, flag renewal risk.
